title: L’obéissance
through_line: Une journée d’un enfant à la maison : on lui demande, il fait, on l’aime.

blocks.vo_line: Obéir, c’est faire ce qu’un aîné demande, sans discuter.
blocks.shot: A calm living room, a grandmother gently asking something of a small boy who listens carefully, warm morning light.

blocks.vo_line: Quand maman appelle, je viens tout de suite.
blocks.shot: A mother standing at a doorway calling, a boy running towards her across a tidy courtyard, happy movement.

blocks.vo_line: Un enfant obéissant est aimé de tout le monde.
blocks.shot: A family of four smiling around a small boy, soft hearts floating above them, warm colours.

blocks.vo_line: Si nous voulons réussir dans la vie, obéissons.
blocks.shot: A boy climbing three soft wide steps towards a big glowing star in a gentle sky.
